correctness.rationale: Variation of constants and Ito isometry give the exact kinetic-OU covariance. Its 2-by-2 determinant is strictly positive for every positive step, proving rank 2d. The one-d-Gaussian affine lower bound follows from covariance rank and the Bures--Wasserstein/Eckart--Young characterization, with equality at spectral truncation. The small-step constant and Cholesky sufficiency were reproduced numerically.

originality.rationale: Exact OU transitions, Gaussian Wasserstein/Bures geometry, rank-bounded Bures approximation, and one-Gaussian stationary-density integrators are prior art and excluded from the claim. The inspected sources did not state the kinetic-OU minimum Gaussian-draw theorem together with the sharp best-one-draw local W2 defect in the resource setting highlighted by arXiv:2609.20713. Originality is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The motivating ULMC work makes Gaussian draws an explicit computational resource and reduces new methods to two per iteration. The result shows that two d-normal draws are already necessary and sufficient for exact affine-Gaussian reproduction of the force-free joint position--velocity transition, and quantifies the irreducible one-draw error exactly.
